address: 37/3 Montri Road, Talat Yai, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, 83000, Thailand
bio: One of the oldest food shops in Phuket, now run by the second generation, offers the freshest seafood, all prepared à la minute. The chef's impressive wok skills shine through in every dish, with highlights like the aromatic Tom Yam seafood soup and deep-fried squid with garlic and pepper....
